title: [finding] The population-floor mechanism now exists three times under two spellings — `floorProblem` in one gate, `populationFloorProblem` in two more, with the refusal wording re-typed each time
body:
Filed unassigned and **ungraded** by the `domain:devx` execution PM seat (#6023), session `session_012GKcPZbMoGq7WPzKLfRBTU`. ⛔ Not graded, not routed. #17099's dev established that a shared helper is warranted, deliberately did not build it per its brief, and left a note on the honest extraction boundary. **Re-measured by this seat on `origin/main` before filing** — and the measurement found one more copy than the note describes.

## Measured on `origin/main` (`e57a5c92c2`)

| gate | lines | `MEASURED_POPULATION` | `populationFloorProblem` | `populationProvenanceLine` | `MIN_[A-Z]` |
| :--- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| `check-engine-double-contract.mjs` | 5,317 | 21 | 21 | 10 | 22 |
| `check-type-check-coverage.mjs` | 7,389 | 19 | 19 | 10 | 17 |
| ⭐ `check-dual-build-cjs-loads.mjs` | 1,605 | **0** | **0** | **0** | 16 |

⇒ **Three implementations, two spellings.** The third is the *precedent the other two were copied from*: it carries the same mechanism under the older name `floorProblem()` (`:528`), with `MIN_ENTRIES` / `MIN_PACKAGES` / `MIN_PROBES` and its own `MEASURED` record. The dev's note described two; there are three, and the odd one out is the original. Nonsense control: `zzznonsense` across `scripts/` = 0.

## What is actually duplicated, and what is not

Diffing the two `populationFloorProblem` bodies (`eng:3077`, `tcc:2246`) — the **row tables share nothing**: 4 rows versus 3, no row in common, and each `why` is a claim about that gate's internals, e.g.

> *"`walk()` swallows a readdir failure and returns what it has, so a scan root that stopped being readable narrows this set in silence"* (engine)
> *"SOURCES_COVERED is decided against this half of the same walk. With none of it every source directory reads as accounted for, because the clause reports the REMAINDER and the remainder of nothing is nothing."* (type-check)

What **is** duplicated is the row-walk and the refusal formatting:

```js
for (const [got, min, measured, what, why] of rows) {
  if (got >= min) continue;
  return `measured only ${got} ${what}, below the floor of ${min} `
    + `(${measured} on ${MEASURED_POPULATION.ref}).\n` … ;
}
return null;
```

⇒ ⚠️ **Sized honestly: this is roughly 20 lines of mechanism across two files, plus `populationProvenanceLine`.** It is not a large extraction, and ⛔ a card that oversells it will produce a refactor with more churn than value. The reason to do it is not line count — it is that **the refusal wording is now typed out in three places**, and that wording is the thing an operator acts on. Three copies is three places for it to drift, and the drift would be invisible because each gate's self-test asserts only its own text.

## The extraction boundary — the dev's note, which I am adopting as the ruling

> The honest extraction is **the row-walk plus the provenance formatting, parameterised by the row table**. ⛔ The row tables themselves must stay in their own gates, because each `why` is a claim about that gate's internals.

## The question this card must answer first, ⛔ which I am NOT ruling

**Does the helper absorb `check-dual-build-cjs-loads`'s `floorProblem()` too, or only the two new ones?**

- Absorbing all three deletes the second spelling and makes the correct form the only one spelled — #12911's **(b)**, and the stronger outcome.
- ⚠️ But that gate's floor predates both and is load-bearing on a different population shape (`entries` / `packages` / `cjsFiles` / `probes` / `typedJudged`, five rows, each with a `MEASURED.ref`). Retrofitting it is a change to a gate this card is not otherwise touching, on a file that has been stable.

⇒ ⛔ Measure what retrofitting the third gate actually costs **before** choosing. Two gates is a refactor; three is a small migration.

## ⚠️ Hazard the extraction will hit

`check:entry-guard` refuses a `scripts/**` file that **exports a binding AND runs on import**. #17099's dev hit exactly this and had to de-export its two new functions. A shared helper module that only exports and never runs on import is fine — but ⛔ confirm that against the gate rather than assuming, and note the two gates' own functions are currently *module-local for that reason*, so the extraction changes their linkage, not just their location.

⚠️ ⛔ This list is not complete. I measured the three implementations, the row-table divergence, the entry-guard interaction and the spelling split. I did **not** sweep for other gates carrying an unnamed floor of the same shape, and did not check whether `scripts/check-declared-population-live.mjs` (which exists and is adjacent by name) is related.

## Sequencing

⚠️ Both target gates changed **today** (#17099). ⛔ Do not dispatch this on top of a fresh landing without re-taking the anchors — and prefer letting #17117 (the `--write` floor, which touches the same engine gate) land first, so a refactor is not competing with a behaviour fix on one file.

## Dedup

Searched open cards for a floor-helper / duplication card: none found. ⚠️ The repo-scoped search endpoint is refused by this container's proxy, so this was a label-page walk and is **weaker than exhaustive**.

Refs #13014 (the class), PR #17099 (which created the second and third copies and named this), #17117 (the `--write` residual on the same gate), #12911 (the remediation-shape ranking).
